services.name: Parasailing
services.desc: Parasailing has become a global phenomenon, with its popularity soaring in recent years. Nowhere is this trend more evident than on the sun-drenched shores of South Padre Island, Texas, which has firmly established itself as the most popular parasailing destination on the entire Texas coast. In fact, this tropical paradise attracts twice as many adventure seekers to its skies than other popular spots like Port Aransas and Galveston combined. This thrilling water sport allows participants to experience the exhilarating feeling of flying high above the sparkling Gulf waters while being securely attached to a parachute. services.name: Banana Boat Rides
services.desc: Looking for exciting banana boat rides in South Padre Island? Sonny’s Beach Service offers thrilling banana boat rides right from the beach, giving you a fun and memorable way to experience the Gulf of Mexico. Rides depart every 20 minutes and accommodate 1 to 6 riders at a time. Whether you’re visiting for the day or staying at a beachfront resort, our banana boat rides are open to the public and easy to access. Banana boat rides are one of the most popular water sports in South Padre Island. Riders sit on an inflatable banana-shaped boat that is pulled by a speedboat along the shoreline. blurb: Sonny's Beach Service offers parasailing over the Gulf of Mexico with licensed and US Coast Guard approved captains. They also provide banana boat rides and beach rentals including chairs and umbrellas. The company has over 40 years of experience and operates on the beach in front of major resorts and hotels in South Padre Island.
